tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List Mythos models
tools.description: List every AI model Mythos can route to, with its exact model id, family, and routing path.

tools.name: list_personas
tools.title: List Mythos personas
tools.description: List the Mythos personas (Oracle, Code Sage, Muse, Tutor, Strategist, Dreamer) that shape how answers are written.

tools.name: ask_mythos
tools.title: Ask Mythos
tools.description: Ask a question through Mythos using a specific model and persona. Returns the model's full answer as markdown.

prompt.description: The question or instruction for Mythos.

model.description: Exact model id from list_models. Defaults to openai/gpt-5.6-sol.

persona.description: Persona id from list_personas. Defaults to oracle.
